mentions.name: HomeFree
mentions.description: All-in-one home server appliance combining a router, NAS, firewall, adblock, and optional app server, each piece optional. Built on NixOS so it is declarative and reproducible, but administered through a web UI so users don't need to know NixOS. All state is managed in a backup bundle so it can be hosted at home or in the cloud; the goal is to plug the box in like a wifi access point, follow a simple web-based installation flow, and be running a personal cloud.
